text:
Type: woven jute chevron rug
Use: covering a large floor area; living room, dining room, bedroom
Style: rustic, coastal, contemporary
Materials: natural jute, chunky flat weave
Colors: natural tan, dark brown
Shape: large rectangle, all-over herringbone chevron pattern, coarse woven texture, flat and sturdy
Feel: earthy, natural, textured
Goes with: dark wood floors, grey upholstery, woven baskets; rustic, coastal or farmhouse rooms

product.name: Rivet Natural Chevron Rug, 7'6" x 9'6", Tan
product.description: 100% Jute Imported With its chevron v-shaped pattern and neutral hues, this area rug is equal parts modern and earthy. Handwoven with 100% natural jute fibers, this durable essential is ideal for low- to medium-traffic spaces. Area rug features a two-tone chevron pattern Handwoven with 100% natural jute fibers Medium 0.33'' pile suits low- to medium-traffic indoor areas Pair with a rug pad (sold separately) 7'6" x 9'6" Ships tightly rolled in a protective bag Unroll, allow a few days for natural fibers to settle.
